blocks.text: In light of the recent amendments to the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, notified vide G.S.R. 775(E) dated 22 October 2025, which mandate that takedown intimations issued by Police Administration must be authorised by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Inspector General of Police, the following order is hereby issued.

1. In accordance with Notification No. 05/Vividh-08/05/2024-6860 dated 11.12.2024 issued by the Department of Home, Prison & Disaster Management, Government of Jharkhand, designating the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) as the agency under Section 79(3)(b) of the Information Technology Act, 2000, the earlier Order No. 463/G.S. dated 18.11.2025 of the Inspector General of Police, CID, Jharkhand, Ranchi is hereby amended.

2. It is hereby ordered that the, Inspector General of Police (Org.Crime), Criminal Investigation Department, Jharkhand, Ranchi is designated as the Nodal Officer under Clause (b) of sub-section (3) of Section 79 of the Information Technology Act, 2000 for issuance of takedown notices to the appropriate Intermediaries as defined under the IT Act and Rules framed thereunder.
3. This order shall come into force with immediate effect and until further orders.
